purpose: Append-only RESEARCH ledger for E0/E1 screens. This is a THIN DISCOVERY LAYER in front of the existing harness, NOT a new experiment framework. E0/E1 records here are non-claiming and may never be cited as results. On promotion to E2 an idea receives an experiment_id and enters experiments/registry.jsonl under the unchanged pre-registration rule.
hard_rule: GRAPH_POLICY 13.2 -- E0/E1 run ONLY on the exploration partition and NEVER read, join, plot or describe the E2 confirmation holdout. This is what makes screening many ideas statistically free rather than a machine for false confidence.
promotion_disclosure: an E2 preregistration states how many E0 leads its campaign screened (GRAPH_POLICY 13.3), so a reader can distinguish a 1-of-50 survivor from a 1-of-2 survivor
do_not: do not build tooling around this file before using it. Append with a two-line script. The failure mode this whole directive exists to prevent is spending another 948 minutes on machinery.

core_claim: Observed recent performance = underlying player tendency/form + the context that produced it. Estimate the underlying tendency as cleanly as possible using SHIFTED, CONTEXT-NORMALIZED EWMAs at the LOWEST USEFUL stat/substat level, then apply it to the NEW context of today's matchup via interaction structure.
the_shape_of_the_expected_edge: not one magic feature, but MANY SMALL context corrections and interaction effects assembled coherently
first_class_decomposition_rule: KEEP OPPORTUNITY AND EFFICIENCY SEPARATE WHEREVER THE DATA ALLOWS. The user flags this decomposition as especially important. A rate that fuses them hides which half moved.

worked_examples_from_the_user_verbatim.rebounding: instead of `player rebound EWMA`, think `rebound opportunities x probability of securing an opportunity`, each component normalized for the contexts that generated the historical observations: opponent rebounding strength, teammate competition, lineup size, role, shot-location mix. Then interact the resulting player tendency with today's expected opposing lineup and matchup.
worked_examples_from_the_user_verbatim.three_point: instead of `player 3P% EWMA`, decompose toward `3PA opportunity x shot-location distribution x context-adjusted conversion`, potentially separately for corner 3s, above-break 3s, rim attempts, paint attempts, and whatever granularity the data supports.

channels_to_apply_it_across: shot attempts and conversion by location/type
any other decomposable player behavior we can observe
axes_to_vary_and_test: normalization schemes (what context is divided out, and how)
EWMA horizons and alphas (NOT assumed; the score lane's own span was never tuned)
decomposition depth (how far down the substat tree the data supports)
interaction formulations (tendency x today's opposing lineup)
hierarchical fallbacks (player -> role -> archetype -> league, for thin support)
alternative frameworks entirely, if research suggests something better
explicitly_not_an_architectural_commandm: This is a MAJOR HYPOTHESIS for the ideas factory, not a mandate. Alternative frameworks are in scope and may displace it.
hard_process_constraint: DO NOT turn this into one massive combinatorial model. Run it through E0 -> E1 -> E2 -> E3 (GRAPH_POLICY section 13). Cheaply test whether INDIVIDUAL normalization and interaction concepts produce signal, log every attempt, kill weak ideas fast, and COMBINE COMPONENTS ONLY AFTER EACH DEMONSTRATES INDEPENDENT VALUE.
why_this_is_plausible_here: the program's own measured history supports the shape: intrinsic player signal IS real under known lineups (the oracle-conditioned stint result), while the same signal dissolved when pushed through a projected-exposure pipeline - i.e. the tendency estimate was not the failure, the context/exposure mapping was. See the P3 completion record.
evidence_status: NONE. This is a thesis, not a result. Nothing here may be cited as evidence.

hypothesis: Rebounds decompose into rebound OPPORTUNITIES x PROBABILITY OF SECURING one, and modelling the two separately beats a single rebound EWMA.
reasoning: user worked example under T1; opportunity and conversion respond to different context (opponent rebounding strength, teammate competition, lineup size, role, shot-location mix) and a fused rate hides which half moved
source_of_idea: user directive 2026-08-07 (D060), stated verbatim as a worked example
data_required: rebound chances / available misses; team and opponent lineup size; teammate competition for the same board; shot-location mix

hypothesis: Three-point production decomposes into 3PA OPPORTUNITY x SHOT-LOCATION DISTRIBUTION x CONTEXT-ADJUSTED CONVERSION, separately for corner vs above-break (and rim/paint for the general shot case), and beats a single 3P% EWMA.
reasoning: user worked example under T1; corner and above-break threes have different base rates and different generative context, so a pooled percentage averages over a mixture that itself shifts with role and lineup
source_of_idea: user directive 2026-08-07 (D060), stated verbatim as a worked example
data_required: shot-level location/type data at sufficient granularity; attempt counts by zone

core_claim: The eventual champion is unlikely to be one monolithic model. It is more likely an ENSEMBLE of specialized models/layers, each solving a narrower problem, whose outputs are combined and calibrated with WEIGHTS LEARNED FROM CLEAN DATA rather than assumed.
companion_thesis: T1_CONTEXT_NORMALIZED_TENDENCY_X_MATCHUP is layer 2 of this architecture
neither_thesis_is_sacred: The ideas factory MUST be allowed to propose completely different architectures if evidence supports them. This is a working thesis, not a fixed architecture.

3_matchup_interaction.user_description: context-normalized player states x today's expected opponent/lineup: rebounder x opponent size, rim attacker x rim defense, shooter location x opponent location allowance, turnover tendency x defensive pressure, role/usage x expected teammates available
3_matchup_interaction.prior_art: essentially UNEXPLORED at player level. The only analogue is the TEAM-level opponent-adjusted interacting structure directed for cycle 2 (D043/D047), which is currently halted pre-fit.
3_matchup_interaction.status: THE LARGEST GENUINELY OPEN FRONTIER, and the user's own candidate for largest incremental signal. Highest-value target for E0 sweeps.

4_bottom_up_aggregation.user_description: sum of expected minutes x expected player component production
4_bottom_up_aggregation.prior_art: THIS IS WHAT P3 DID, AND IT FAILED - all five arms FAIL, zero promoted. CRITICAL NUANCE: the failure was localized. Intrinsic player signal IS real under KNOWN lineups (oracle-conditioned stint result, preserved as valid evidence); it dissolved only when pushed through PROJECTED exposure. The coefficients were not the problem - layer 1 was.
4_bottom_up_aggregation.status: BLOCKED ON LAYER 1, not on itself. Re-attempting it without a materially better exposure artifact repeats a measured failure. Note the standing guard: the frozen P3 coefficients may be reused ONLY IF a materially different exposure artifact is developed for an INDEPENDENTLY JUSTIFIED reason - the prior failure is explicitly NOT authorisation to build one.

5_structural_team_model.user_description: do not assume bottom-up automatically replaces the structural channel
5_structural_team_model.prior_art: EXISTS - the pace x efficiency composite. Measured: it does NOT beat two-season-average scoring and trails the market by a paired 0.383 total MAE / 0.797 margin MAE / 0.0168 Brier.
5_structural_team_model.status: RETAIN AS AN ENSEMBLE MEMBER per the user. Its weight is an empirical question, not an assumption - and a weak member can still add value if its errors are decorrelated from the player layer's.

6_residual_specialist.user_description: coaching, travel, lineup continuity, refs, unusual matchups, news
6_residual_specialist.prior_art: D051 already mandates residual characterisation against a correlate list FROZEN BEFORE unsealing - that is the existing bridge and it is designed to pick these targets by measured signal instead of intuition. Note referee effects were already withdrawn by measurement (SC07).
6_residual_specialist.status: OPEN, with an existing mechanism to prioritise it

7_outcome_distribution_calibration.user_description: calibrated distributions for score, margin, total and player outcomes rather than only point estimates
7_outcome_distribution_calibration.prior_art: PARTIAL PRECEDENT: M13 built a point-prediction-to-probability translation with the distributional assumption made explicit and fitted out-of-sample (Student-t, df=8 by AIC, from 16,162 disjoint OOF residuals). It measured the translated model as WORSE calibrated than the market.
7_outcome_distribution_calibration.status: OPEN; the translation machinery exists and is reusable

8_separate_market_model.user_description: model the market independently; market information must not contaminate the basketball model
8_separate_market_model.prior_art: ALREADY FROZEN LAW. MARKET_PROGRAM_CONTRACT section 2, 'The four-system separation - FROZEN': S-FUND (fundamental) / S-MKT (market-reaction) / S-EXEC (execution) / S-DEC (decision-portfolio), each exposing a defined interface, and 'None substitutes for another: no output of one system is ever accepted as evidence belonging to another.'
8_separate_market_model.status: ALREADY SATISFIED ARCHITECTURALLY. Nothing to design; it is enforced.

9_conditional_edge_decision.user_description: identify where our information is unusually valuable, abstain elsewhere, size appropriately
9_conditional_edge_decision.prior_art: S-DEC owns staking/exposure/correlation control in the frozen contract, and GRAPH_POLICY 13.5 (D057, today) already demotes global MAE in favour of conditional edge plus abstention.
9_conditional_edge_decision.status: ARCHITECTURALLY HOMED; the open work is empirical - what observable pre-game state predicts our advantage

coordinator_synthesis_of_the_map: Of the nine layers: two (8, 9) already have frozen architectural homes; two (1, 4) have been ATTEMPTED AND FAILED in a way that localises the blocker to layer 1; one (5) exists and is retained; one (2) is T1; one (7) has reusable machinery; one (6) has an existing prioritisation mechanism. **Layer 3 is the largest genuinely unexplored surface** - which is also where the user expects the most incremental signal. That convergence is the clearest steer available for where E0 sweeps should start.
process_constraint: Do NOT build the enormous final ensemble. Break into testable hypotheses, cheaply screen normalizations, EWMA structures, decompositions, interactions and specialist models at E0, document every attempt, and combine ONLY components that demonstrate independent signal.
evidence_status: NONE. This is a thesis, not a result. Nothing here may be cited as evidence.

what_the_coordinator_said: that the P3 failure 'localises to layer 1' and that layer 4 (bottom-up aggregation) is 'blocked on layer 1, not on itself'
why_that_was_too_strong: known-lineup performance STRONGLY IMPLICATES projected exposure/minutes as the bottleneck, but it does not CLEAR sum(minutes x production) itself. The oracle-conditioned result shows intrinsic signal exists under known lineups; it does not demonstrate that the aggregation step is sound once exposure is fixed. Those are different claims and the coordinator collapsed them.
operational_consequence: do NOT rerun layer 4 unchanged. A MATERIALLY IMPROVED exposure artifact WOULD justify retesting aggregation - and that retest is a genuine open question rather than a formality, because aggregation has never been validated on its own terms.
unchanged: the standing guard still holds: a materially different exposure artifact needs an INDEPENDENTLY JUSTIFIED reason to be built; the prior failure is not that reason.

problem: GRAPH_POLICY 13.2 requires E0/E1 to run only on an exploration partition and never touch the E2 confirmation holdout - but no partition was ever DEFINED. Until one exists, the first E0 screen would violate the rule that makes the sandbox safe.

definition.confirmation_holdout: seasons 2025 and 2026 - NEVER read, joined, plotted or described at E0/E1

rules: E0/E1 may train and test freely INSIDE the exploration partition, including its own internal season splits.
E0/E1 may not read the confirmation holdout in any form - not for counts, not for coverage checks, not for plots.
An E2 preregistration is written BEFORE the holdout is touched, and confirmation runs on the holdout.
This is a DEFAULT the user may override. It is strictly more conservative than the status quo (no rule at all), so it cannot weaken any existing gate.
caveat_stated_not_hidden: 2026 is an in-progress season (215 games and growing), so the holdout GROWS over time. That is acceptable for confirmation but means holdout size is not fixed; any E2 must pin the holdout rows it used by hash, exactly as the score lane pins master_team.
